end.summary:
Discussed unity in diversity using festivals, food, language, and clothing examples.
Riya connected different festivals with shared gratitude and different foods with shared nourishment.
Riya stated that living together can be common without everyone being the same.
Teach-back was not completed; the lesson ended when Riya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that different traditions can share a common purpose, using festivals and food as examples. Riya explained the shared feelings and needs clearly and noted that being different is not a problem. The clothing example was repeated several times, and Riya became tired before the final teach-back; this was not corrected later. At home, invite Riya to make a small “different forms, common purpose” chart with two new examples.
